ideas.title: Investigation into Minnesota Anti-ICE Signal Group Chats
ideas.description: The FBI is investigating Minnesota anti-ICE Signal group chats. This story could explore the reasons behind the investigation and the potential implications for free speech and activism.
questions: What are the implications of the investigation for free speech?
How common are anti-ICE Signal group chats?
ideas.insight: This investigation could have significant implications for free speech and activism, particularly in the context of social media and online organizing.
